description: React component for sharing and publishing a board, including internal and public sharing options, linking to channels, and permission management.

methods.name: isLastAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the list of board members contains only one admin.

methods.name: createSharingInfo
methods.description: Creates a new sharing info object with a generated token.

methods.name: onShareChanged
methods.description: Handles toggling the sharing (publish to web) feature.

methods.name: onLinkBoard
methods.description: Links the board to a channel, with optional confirmation.

methods.name: onRegenerateToken
methods.description: Regenerates the sharing token and updates sharing info.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user to the board with the minimum role.

methods.name: onUpdateBoardMember
methods.description: Updates a board member's permissions, ensuring at least one admin remains.

methods.name: onDeleteBoardMember
methods.description: Deletes a board member, ensuring at least one admin remains.
